coverage.evidence_summary: Complete country-based M49 021 fabric reviewed through bounded culture-area sheets and eight checked archaeological or political centers; no unsupported hard frontier is asserted.

All 3986 assignments replace the generic provisional actor for exactly 1444-11-11, including late Norse Greenland, Thule/Inuit, village, chiefdom, town, mobile-community, and uninhabited-island records.
Every assignment carries an evidence-bounded community, town, village-network, or chiefdom grouping rather than a modern-state or later contact-era tribal projection.
Date-valid records keep distinct Norse, Thule/Inuit, Iroquoian, Mississippian, Hohokam, Puebloan, Pacific, Plains, woodland, subarctic, and uninhabited-island fabrics.
